license_review_scope: Public card/API metadata only. Public card also says research purposes and refers to Salesforce acceptable-use policies. Actual gated acknowledgement terms were not accepted or modified.

documented_format.basis: Public dataset card and its documentation example, not privately accessed dataset rows.
documented_format.tool_parameters: parameter-name to definition mapping; required is per parameter; example types include int and list
documented_format.answers: array of function names and argument objects

conversion_requirements: Decode serialized tools and answers with strict JSON, reject duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers; retain query text.
Build each function parameters schema as type object with properties and top-level required; do not pass the parameter-name map straight to the Qwen tool template.

Explicitly map documented primitive type aliases such as int to integer and float to number. list maps to array but requires separate review of element/item constraints. Reject unsupported or ambiguous nested types instead of inventing constraints.
Keep assistant tool-call arguments as objects for the checked Qwen template, not JSON strings. Use one assistant target containing all answer calls with deterministic unique IDs.
Do not fabricate tool results or convert parallel answer calls into a claimed sequential executed trajectory. Source execution verification is an upstream claim, not locally reproduced Kumi evidence.
Check function naming constraints and preserve a reversible alias map if a runtime needs aliases; do not rename unrelated APIs into Kumi operations.
Create API/function-family and near-duplicate-aware train/validation groups; repository exposes train only.
Verify exact local Qwen template rendering, argument types, sequence length, final-target masking and padding loss before any training.
Keep attribution, APIGen citation, pinned revision, source IDs, data hashes and transformation version with every converted record.
recommended_role: Candidate generic function-selection/argument-binding auxiliary corpus. Test a small token-budgeted mixture against Kumi-only training rather than letting all 60000 generic examples dominate the current 492 Kumi records.
release_readiness: Not imported or ready for training. Actual source rows remain gated to the current account.
